title: Flood Fill
description: Write a Zig program that implements the flood fill algorithm on a 2D grid represented as a flat array.
hints: Use a flat array and a width parameter to simulate 2D grid access
Flood fill replaces all adjacent cells of the same color with a new color
Index calculation: `y * width + x` maps 2D coordinates to a flat index
Base case: return if out of bounds or if cell doesn't match oldColor
